# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy black hair, and rosy cheeks. She inherits a merry facial expression from her father and is known for her dimples.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)_

## Personality

Diana is a sweet, merry, and loyal girl who laughs frequently before speaking. She is practical, affectionate, and deeply devoted to her friends, though she lacks Anne's hyper-imaginative flair and feels shocked by things she considers improper or wicked.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P29](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0029), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v2 c18 P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051)_

## Traits

- Merry and cheerful  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026)</sub>
- Loyal and honest  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>
- Fond of reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing

## Goals

- To be a faithful bosom friend to Anne  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>
- To be a good mother and provide her child with sweet early memories  <sub>[v3 c39 P47](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0047)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry meets Anne Shirley shortly after Anne arrives at Green Gables, and the two young girls solemnly swear to be faithful bosom friends forever. They spend their childhood playing together, building a playhouse in the woods, and sharing imaginative adventures. When Anne accidentally jumps onto Aunt Josephine Barry in the spare room bed during a sleepover, Diana faithfully stands by Anne and refuses to tell on her. Over the years, Diana participates in local community events, including the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and the Christmas Concert. When the Improvers decide to paint the hall, she joins Anne and their peers in dismay upon discovering it was accidentally painted bright blue. Diana supports Anne through various mishaps, such as holding an umbrella for her when Anne gets trapped in the roof of the Cobb duckhouse during a rainstorm and supplying paper for Anne's writing. Eventually, Diana marries Fred Wright and settles down, later giving birth to her first child, a son named little Fred.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v2 c9 P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 c9 P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033), [v2 c18 P48](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0048), [v2 c18 P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042), [v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
